blocks.text: Showbiz updates, celebrity stories, and product finds will take center stage in GMA Network’s newest show, “Chika Cart,” which will be hosted by comedian Donita Nose, actress Baninay Bautista, and veteran entertainment journalist Jeff Fernando. Fernando, who served as the head writer of the 2001 talk show “Sis” hosted by Gelli, Janice de Belen, and Carmina Villarroel, brings more than 30 years of experience in media and his extensive network in the entertainment industry to the program.
